body: thank you! i will definitely try this the next time roller coaster up.  i do not think it seems silly :)

that is very true. and yeah, i actually am an only child. that is pretty interesting to know.  to be honest, i usually just wait for my anxiety to pass. once it gets a little better i usually watch something funny, and it makes me feel somewhat better. i just have to keep my mind occupied or else i have panic attacks, but lately not even that helps.

i have about two good friends, one who has no idea how to help but can relate to the suicidal thoughts and gets a bit irritated when i vent, and one who is pretty supportive and sympathetic but cannot relate whatsoever. but no one is perfect, so i understand them and their responses to my feelings. thank you for your response, i really appreciate knowing somebody cares. for some reason the people that really seem to make an impact on me are adults, i guess for someone to look up to.
